chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him)
About the condition of the people before the descent of revelation and his performance in conveying the message
ai.seo_question: What was the condition of people before prophethood and how did the Prophet spread his message?
ai.summary: This passage from Nahj al-Balagha highlights the Jahiliyyah (Age of Ignorance) as a period of spiritual and moral decay, contrasting it with the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him) mission to restore divine guidance. Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the transformative power of the message, framing the Prophet's efforts not merely as preaching but as a comprehensive revival of monotheism and ethical clarity for a society lost in idolatry and tribalism.
